items.title: 56800_John Simmons oral history interview
items.q: That's where Harold Land and I stopped. We had adjoining rooms, you know.

ctx.x: Well, then, after they closed the Moulin Rouge down they opened another hotel, the Clark Hotel. And they had a setup for music, but they didn't have a casino or anything like that. Just had a bar, you know, and a bandstand. And the back room was a larger room with a larger bandstand, and they used that for rehearsal band purposes mostly. You know, the jazz musicians that was working on the strip in the main room didn't get a chance to play jazz, so they'd come over there and sit in with the rehearsal band, in…
I was down there in '62 with Louis Bellson. That's where Harold Land and I stopped. We had adjoining rooms, you know.
Was that when it opened? The Clark opened in '62?
